---
description: "Testing skill trigger"
applyTo: "**/*.test.ts, **/*.spec.ts, **/*.test.js, **/*.spec.js, **/*_test.go, **/test_*.py, **/*_test.py"
---

You MUST invoke the `testing-expert` skill before writing or modifying tests. This skill contains Vista's testing standards (Vitest, Playwright, Pytest) and testing patterns.
